title: SafeSteps
description: SafeSteps is a survival utility plugin that lets players toggle fall damage immunity and shows exact death coordinates with world info.
body:
✨ SafeSteps Features ->

🪂 Toggle Fall Damage with /nofall command

💀 Death Coordinates sent directly in chat after dying

🔒 Settings persist after restart for reliable use

⚡ Lightweight and survival-friendly utility plugin

Perfect for multiplayer & survival servers where safety and info matter most!
